info.name: EchoTik API — ValidDs
info.description:
EchoTik API endpoints for ValidDs: Products, Search, and Shops.

Auth: Basic Authentication — set ECHOTIK_USERNAME and ECHOTIK_PASSWORD in the collection variables. The pre-request script handles Base64 encoding and injects the Authorization header automatically.

The requestId returned in every response is a unique trace ID from EchoTik's backend. It is automatically captured into LAST_REQUEST_ID after each call. Log it alongside your own request logs for debugging failed or unexpected responses.

variable.description: Auto-populated from the first product_id in a Product List or Ranking List response.
Auto-populated from the first seller_id in a Product List or Shop List response.
Automatically captured from the last response. Use this when reporting issues to EchoTik support.

query.description: REQUIRED. Region code e.g. US, UK, ID, TH, VN, MY, PH, SG
REQUIRED. Page number, starts from 1, max 100,000
First captured date range start, format yyyyMMdd (optional)
First captured date range end, format yyyyMMdd (optional)

request.description:
Primary ingestion source. T+1 updated. Returns product_id, product_name, pricing, cover_url, category, region, sales_trend_flag, and full time-windowed sales metrics (1d/7d/15d/30d/60d/90d) for both unit sales and GMV.

Use this as the seed for your BullMQ ingestion job. Paginate through all pages, then enrich top products with the Batch Detail endpoint.

NOTE: page_size max is 10. Pagination uses page_num (not page) and page_size (not limit). End of data is signalled by an empty data array.

query.description: REQUIRED. Date in yyyy-MM-dd format. Weekly = always a Monday; Monthly = always the 1st of the month

request.description:
Best-selling and most-promoted product rankings. Returns incremental data for the selected period — values represent growth within that window, not cumulative totals.

This is your primary trendScore signal — ranked products have pre-validated market demand. Run daily (rank_type=1) in your ingestion job.

NOTE: rank_type replaces the old 'period' string param. product_rank_field 2 ranks by creator count, not 'featured'.

query.description: REQUIRED. Product ID from Product List or Ranking List

request.description:
Historical daily trend snapshots for a specific product, up to the past 180 days. Each entry is a point-in-time snapshot of that product's metrics on that date.

Powers your frontend trend charts and feeds trendDirection ('rising' | 'peaked' | 'saturating') on ExtractedProduct.

NOTE: path is /product/trend (not /product/trends).

query.description: REQUIRED. Comma-separated product IDs, max 10 per call. e.g. id1,id2,id3

request.description:
Full product enrichment: desc_detail (structured description blocks with text + images), sale_props (variants/SKUs), specification, review_count, skus with real_price.

Call after product/list or product/ranklist to hydrate top products. The desc_detail text feeds your Claude AI extraction layer as rawText.

NOTE: path is /product/detail (not /product/detail/batch). No region param — product_ids is the only required param.

Verified buyer reviews for a product collected by EchoTik. Better signal than comment scraping. Use review text to populate sentimentSummary and buyingIntentScore on ExtractedProduct via Claude extraction.

NOTE: path is /product/comment (not /product/review/list).

request.description: Which TikTok videos are driving sales for this product. Links products back to content — lets you show dropshippers the viral videos behind a product's momentum. Maps to your sourceVideoId / sourceVideoUrl fields.

Lists all influencers associated with selling this product. Returns core creator identifiers and sales metrics — for full creator details, call the Batch Influencer Details endpoint using the returned user_id values.
Live stream sessions associated with selling this product. Shows which live broadcasts drove sales — useful for identifying top-performing live sellers for this niche.

query.description: REQUIRED. Search keyword. Supports fuzzy search (2+ words) and precise search.
REQUIRED. Entity type: product / influencer / shop / video / live

request.description:
Unified search across products, shops, videos, and creators by keyword. Returns max 30 results with core metrics. Supports fuzzy and precise search modes.

Powers your frontend search bar in ValidDs. Note: fewer fields returned than list endpoints — use this for discovery, then call detail endpoints to enrich results.

Reverse image search across EchoTik's product catalog. A dropshipper uploads a product photo found anywhere (competitor ad, AliExpress, etc.) and instantly finds the matching TikTok Shop listing.

Strong frontend differentiator. Replace image_url with a publicly accessible image URL.

NOTE: path is /product/image_search (not /search/image).

Discovery feed for competitor shops. T+1 updated. Returns seller_name, seller_id, total_sale_cnt, total_sale_gmv_amt, time-windowed sales (1d/7d/30d/90d), total_product_cnt, spu_avg_price, rating, and sales_trend_flag.

Ingests into your Store MongoDB collection. Run in scheduled BullMQ job alongside product ingestion.

query.description: REQUIRED. Date in yyyy-MM-dd. Weekly = Monday, Monthly = 1st of month

request.description:
Top performing shops ranked by GMV for the period. Values are incremental data for the selected window, not lifetime totals.

Competitor intelligence — shows which stores are winning in a given niche. Run daily.

NOTE: rank_type replaces the old 'period' string param (daily/weekly/monthly).

query.description: REQUIRED. Seller ID from Shop List or Shop Ranking List

request.description: Full profile of a specific shop: product count, associated creators, video count, GMV breakdown, category distribution. Use after seller/list or seller/ranklist to enrich Store records on demand.
Historical daily trend snapshots for a specific shop, up to the past 180 days. Mirrors the product trend endpoint but for store-level metrics. Use to assess shop momentum over time.
All products sold by a specific shop. Use to see exactly what a competitor store is selling — great for niche validation and sourcing intelligence.
